title: Compacts authorized.
bodyText: The department is authorized to develop and participate in the development of, negotiate, and enter into one or more interstate compacts on behalf of the State. A compact entered into pursuant to this chapter shall have the force and effect of law.
bodyHtml: §350C-3  Compacts authorized.  The department is authorized to develop and participate in the development of, negotiate, and enter into one or more interstate compacts on behalf of the State.  A compact entered into pursuant to this chapter shall have the force and effect of law. [L 1986, c 110, pt of §1]
